body: Interim mitigation (Termal::Fable2 with Engram::Fable, 2026-10-19 15:35Z), held until TermAl w-33f4cde5413c lands. An acceptance evaluation's naming token appears to be the store-wide canonical history revision, so ANY termal_name_source_root in the SAME store during an evaluator's window makes the submit fail with 409 'source root changed … no longer names'. That's four occurrences on 10-19. Mitigation: around every evaluation, the coordinator of that store declares a naming-quiet window (no lane names a root) until the evaluation records. Engram::Fable does this for the Engram store. TermAl's coordinator must do the same for the TermAl store around TermAl evaluations (M4, w-edb7 and so on): tell lanes 'no termal_name_source_root until X records'. If a holder's OWN journal is stuck (a kept same-path re-name doesn't reset it), the recovery is naming a DIFFERENT path under the same claim (Engram::Opus, w-1d0d, generation 1526).
